NEW MEXICO Tax Credits As-Of: June 2026 Tax Credit: 25-40% refundable (NO per-project caps) New Mexico offers 25% base refundable tax credit with bonuses for TV series/pilots, certified production facilities, local union crew, and rural filming—bringing effective rates to 40% in optimal scenarios. locations.name: BLM Managed Desert Public Lands
locations.fit: Provides wide, unpopulated desert expanses matching the script requirements for Scene 1 (EXT. DESERT - DAY) and Scene 2 (EXT. RIDGE - DAY) where only sand, wind, and barren terrain are present without vehicles or people.
risks: Filming requires Bureau of Land Management (BLM) review and approval; permits depend on field office evaluation of minimum impact.
Environmental challenges including wind, blowing dust, and rapid temperature swings characteristic of New Mexico desert terrain.
Filming permits are not issued by the state film office directly and require local coordination and minimum standard liability insurance coverage ($1,050,000 policy limit).

locations.name: Santa Fe County Exterior Open Terrain & Ridges
locations.fit: Offers barren ridgelines and elevated arid terrain suitable for Scene 2 (EXT. RIDGE - DAY) and surrounding desert plains for Scene 1 with convenient proximity to regional production infrastructure.
risks: Requires municipal/county film permit application with per-day shooting fees and application processing fees regardless of whether property is public or private.
Exposure to high-altitude environmental conditions, blowing sand/dust, and weather variability.
Permit authorization and property access are subject to application review and are not guaranteed in advance.
